name: Amagi Momoka
source:
She is the head of the newly established “Himeyuri Dormitory,” a dormitory for students in the performing arts department. She is a top of the top idol, and her new song quickly achieved 100 million of views. She boasts overwhelming charisma, but her friendly, unpretentious personality and easygoing approach to fan service add to her popularity. Although she is very busy as an idol and there are few chances to see her at the school, many students come to Himeyuri to see her. On the other hand, there are rumors on the Internet that she has a bad personality.

[Translated from the [url=http://liquid.nexton-net.jp/liq42/]official site[/url]]
